title: Treatise on Thrust and Hook for the Paired Blades
summary: Joins the straight thrust to the guard hook so one blade traps while the other drives a qi-sharpened point.

title: The Shearing Canon of Both Blades
summary: Teaches the scissoring closure of both blades on an arm or weapon and how to guard while shearing.

title: Workbook of the Circling Guard
summary: Drills continuous circles of the two blades that turn aside blows while qi keeps the wrists loose and quick.

title: Handbook of Qi-Backed Close Work
summary: Explains how a short pulse of qi in the wrist and elbow lends force to cuts thrown from almost no distance.

title: A Book of Locks Binds and Releases
summary: Sets out how to lock an opposing weapon between the two blades and how to leave a lock when it fails.

title: Rules of the Cross-Cut Exchange
summary: Teaches how to trade cuts through a crossing of the blades so that the exchange ends in the student's favor.

title: The Long Course of the Paired Blades
summary: A long graded course that carries a student from plain alternating strokes to qi-led pair work.

title: Forms for Fighting Inside a Spear's Reach
summary: Shows how to turn a long weapon's strength into weakness by getting under the shaft with both blades.

title: Notes on the Two-Blade Counterstroke
summary: Trains the instant answer of one blade to a blow the other has just turned aside with qi.
